name: Li Auto Inc.
sector: Automotive / China new energy vehicles (EREV + BEV premium SUVs)
moat_justification: Once-clear EREV/family-SUV differentiation has been copied by Huawei AITO, Leapmotor and others, pricing power has collapsed (vehicle margin 19.4% to 9.4% YoY in Q2 2026), and the ROIC history in fundamentals.json is volatile and mostly negative with only 2024 strongly positive, while gross margin fell from 22.2% in FY2023 to 18.7% in FY2025 and 11.0% in Q2 2026. Brand, scale, charging network and in-house tech give some franchise value, but no durable lock-in — moat 3/10, weak.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.3%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency CNY converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x2.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Li Auto Inc. Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-10): ADSs each representing two Class A ordinary shares; the same ratio is stated in the company's ADS offering announcements (each ADS representing two Class A ordinary shares, Nasdaq: LI; HKEX: 2015)) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -1.88 vs 3-yr median 0.72 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
BIG_NET_CASH: net cash is 4.4x normalized OE — part of the price is a cash pile, not the operating business; note it in the verdict
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (7.8%) vs bull-case tier C (12.5%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: China premium NEV maker in a downturn, moat 3/10 — does not clear 15%: Tier D, weighted IRR 9.2%, IV@15% $6.06 per ADS vs $11.34; clears 15% only under ~$6.06, with the large net cash pile cushioning but not offsetting collapsing margins and negative latest OE.
moat_for: Family-SUV brand and cabin/living-space positioning in the RMB 200,000+ segment, where it held a top NEV position in Q2 2026
Scale: over RMB 100B revenue for three straight years and 406,000 deliveries in 2025 despite the decline
Owned retail/service footprint and 5C supercharging network (4,141 stations at end-July 2026 per Q2 2026 reporting)
In-house stack in development: Mach M100 chip, 5C batteries, drive-by-wire chassis and VLA assisted driving
Fortress cash: RMB 87.5B cash position at Q2 2026 and buybacks ($631.5M repurchased) cushion the downturn
moat_against: EREV differentiation copied: Huawei AITO, Leapmotor and others now sell extended-range family SUVs into Li Auto's exact niche
No lock-in or network effect: buyers cross-shop on price/spec with near-zero switching costs in a China price war
Pricing power lost: vehicle gross margin fell from 19.4% in Q2 2025 to 9.4% in Q2 2026; FY2025 gross margin 18.7% down from 20.5%
BEV transition rocky: MEGA recall cost over RMB 1.1B in Q3 2025 and BEV models are not yet offsetting EREV decline
ROIC not sustained above cost of capital: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json was negative in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2025, with only 2024 strongly positive
